Call, or Send a Roofing Request

For water coming in or storm damage, call: the line answers at any hour. For an inspection, a second opinion or a roof you are starting to worry about, the form works too.

Calling is quickest

For a leak, storm damage or anything happening right now, call (832) 662-4107. Day or night, an automated assistant takes the call and connects you with a local roofing company.

While you wait, keep it safe: stay off the roof, move belongings away from the drip, put a bucket and towels under it, keep people out of any room where the ceiling sags, and photograph the damage from the ground and inside. Report downed power lines to CenterPoint Energy or 911.

Call (832) 662-4107

Or send a request

Good for an inspection, a second opinion on a quote, or a roof you want looked at before storm season. Your details go to a local roofing company, which calls you back to arrange a visit.

Your details are passed only to the roofing company that will call you back. They are not sold. See the privacy policy and terms.

About this line: Houston Expert Roofers is a free phone line, not a roofing contractor. It answers your call and connects you with an independent local roofing company, which inspects, quotes and does the work, and which you pay directly. Companies may pay a referral fee. The line never charges you. Read how the line works.

Questions Houston homeowners ask

Is calling or the form faster?

Calling. The assistant picks up day or night and puts you through before you hang up. The form passes your details to a local roofing company, which calls you back when it can. If water is coming in, call, and follow the safe steps on the emergency roof repair page while you wait.

Who receives the details I send?

An independent, locally owned roofing company that takes calls in your area, so it can call you back. Your details are not sold. The privacy policy explains how information is handled.

Do you have an email address or an office I can visit?

No. There is no public office and no email address; Houston Expert Roofers is simply a phone line and a website. Call the number or use the form on this page. Inspections and estimates are arranged directly with the roofing company you are connected with.
